description: This source file defines a class 'Filesystem' within the OrangeHRM project, extending the Symfony Filesystem component to add a method 'dumpFile' that writes content to a file, creating directories if necessary, with error handling.

classes.name: Filesystem
classes.description: A custom Filesystem class extending Symfony's Filesystem, with an enhanced 'dumpFile' method for writing files with directory creation and error handling.

methods.name: dumpFile
methods.description: Writes content to a specified file, creating parent directories if they don't exist, with error handling that throws an exception upon failure.
